scope: Prep11 PDF pagination and its export regression guard

retainedDefaultSafariPdf.priorInspection: All six pages visually reviewed; 131 expected text fragments retained; no blank or out-of-bounds text. Minor pagination finding, not content loss.

causes.finding: Cards explicitly allowed inside fragmentation; label/heading break-after avoidance alone is not enforced in WebKit paged output.
A repeated source title later in the report concealed the split first citation from the old any-page matcher.
causes.reproduction: Two new Node/Python regression tests failed before the occurrence-specific guard repair, including the retained Safari page text.

candidate.rendering: Normal block containment for short records, questions and source entries; nested lead blocks for oversized records; page-break-inside:avoid plus break-inside:avoid; no fixed height, overflow clipping or forced page break.
candidate.guard: Canonical counts and DOM-occurrence-specific label/title/paragraph/citation pair checks in both-theme native Chromium PDF output, including future reused labels.
candidate.negative: Controlled native Chromium fragmentation with containment disabled; fallback forced page boundary is labeled separately. Historical Safari text is a separate detection fixture.
candidate.oversized: Separate fresh CI page containing one canonical card plus 48 synthetic numbered paragraphs and a final marker; complete multi-page output, lead grouping, meaningful first-page content and canonical computed print-theme parity required. Visual review caught and repaired an initial fixture-only misplaced Cisco class and revision-only preface; neither was a canonical report finding.
candidate.facts: No canonical datasets, source or claim review dates, material cycles, schedules, permissions or activation changes.

verificationLimits.actualLiveDownloadedHtmlInteractiveReope: unverified; prior browser file-protocol security denial remains in force
verificationLimits.safariInteractionDuringInvestigation: none; active user work left untouched
verificationLimits.isolatedWebKitAttempt: A no-window, ephemeral WKWebView print probe using fresh synthetic repository output stalled and produced an incomplete PDF. Its owned process was terminated; no pass is claimed. It did not open retained downloads or control Safari.
verificationLimits.smallestRemainingNativeCheck: When an owner-authorized non-disruptive native session is available, print the candidate Prep11 report in each theme and inspect every page, including labels, qualifications and complete citation entries. Actual live downloaded HTML reopening requires a permitted file-open capability; do not substitute a server, alternate browser surface or indirect execution for the denial.

releaseBoundary: Draft PR and exact-head CI only; separate approval required to merge or deploy. Pilot activation and independent visitor advancement remain governed by their existing gates.
